record.dic_text:
4732 stereoo {ster-eh-o'-o}

源自 4731; TDNT - 7:609,1077; 動詞

欽定本 - receive strength 1, make strong 1, establish 1; 3

1) (身體上) 使堅強, 使強壯
2) (喻意上) 加強 (#徒16:5|)
record.edic_text:
4732 stereoo {ster-eh-o'-o}

from 4731; TDNT - 7:609,1077; v

AV - receive strength 1, make strong 1, establish 1; 3

1) to make solid, make firm, strengthen, make strong
   1a) of the body of anyone

same.cexp: 不能生育的女人，不能懷孕的女人
堅定的；固體（非液體狀食物），乾（飯）
